=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:160-176 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The base-run readers sort by `created_at` and take the newest-created run, not the newest-completed one: the delta verdict jq `sort_by(.created_at // "")` then `last`, scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:164-174 (review_final_ci_sweep_base_ci_red listing and fallback filters), and scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1804-1805 (`[.workflow_runs[]? | ...][0]`). Push and schedule runs are in separate concurrency groups (`ci-push-<ref>` and `ci-schedule-<ref>`), so they overlap, and a delta push created later that finishes green first hides an earlier scheduled full run that fails.
  WHY: The next push treats main as green and runs only the delta suite, the sweep and the triage base gate also read main as green, and ci/final keeps posting "(delta suite)" success on a tree the full suite failed for up to 6 hours, which breaks Goals 4 and 6; all reviewers rated it MAJOR. Suggested fix: `sort_by(.updated_at // .created_at // "")`.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:225-290 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `(.affected_tests // []) as $a` treats a missing or null `affected_tests` in the selector JSON as an empty selection. The script then writes full_required=false and runs only the CI-structure tests.
  WHY: A broken selector, or one that regresses (the delta job runs whatever selector version the pushed commit carries), yields CI success on an untested tree, which contradicts the script's "never counts an unknown selection as passed" contract. Severity disagreement: gemini MAJOR, glm NIT; the highest is used.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:85-88 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `ci_main_delta_output` suppresses errors when writing `GITHUB_OUTPUT` and returns success. If writing `full_required=true` fails, the test step is skipped and the job output resolves to false or missing (related ci.yml:5073-5074, 5115-5117, 5282-5284).
  WHY: The lint aggregate accepts skipped gated jobs when the delta job succeeded, so ci/final can post success without running either the selected tests or the full suite. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputed this one, saying lint reads the output as "missing" and fails closed (ci.yml:5281-5295).
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:103-107 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: All scheduled runs share one concurrency group, `ci-schedule-refs/heads/main`, with cancel-in-progress false. GitHub keeps only one pending run per group, so a newer timer run replaces a scheduled run that is still pending.
  WHY: Under runner backlog, scheduled full runs can be dropped without any signal, so neither the 6-hour full-suite cadence nor the 22:30-before-promotion run is guaranteed. Severity disagreement: gemini and luna MAJOR, glm NIT (glm notes the queue wait would have to exceed 6 hours); the highest is used.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:349 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The default test deadline `CI_MAIN_DELTA_TEST_TIMEOUT_SECS:-840` plus the checkout, setup-python, pip install and selector steps puts the designed tests_timed_out fallback at about 15-17 minutes. That is at or above budget-watch's 0.75 x 20 min = 15 min warn threshold for tests-main-delta (ci.yml:5110, 5159).
  WHY: Every push whose delta tests time out (an expected fallback) also files or re-files an `ai:ci-budget` issue, which creates automation churn. Severity disagreement: sonnet and gemini MAJOR, glm NIT; the highest is used. Suggested fix: about a 600 s default.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:70-362 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `CI_MAIN_DELTA_SHARDED_TESTS` lists only `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`, so modules that ci.yml shards inside one job are run whole and serially in a single pytest call, and the selector's `functions` narrowing is ignored. Examples: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py with heal_shards=4, tests/test_review_merge_train.py with mt_shards=3, plus pc/wg1/wg2/ub shards.
  WHY: A change that selects these modules can use the whole 14-minute deadline and only then fall back to the full suite, which adds about 15 minutes to the critical path; both reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Per push to main, 47 jobs before, 3 after (static-checks, the delta job, lint)" and "A push to main starts 3 jobs, not 47."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, budget-watch job
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: budget-watch remains a separate job whose condition includes pushes to `main` at .github/workflows/ci.yml:5122-5141 (push condition at line 5129), so a qualifying push starts four jobs, not three. Severity disagreement: gemini MAJOR, luna NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash judged this not a gap, because the issue says budget-watch already acts on pushes to main and the changelog says "4 after (with budget-watch)".
- requirement: "Watch the first day: ... no promotion starts without a full run from the same day."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml or scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh, before the promotion cycle proceeds
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Neither promotion file is changed, and the new ci.yml schedule is not connected to any promotion gate. The existing test-and-mark-stable.yml gate-only check is advisory at lines 5528-5542, and no code verifies that a scheduled full ci.yml run passed that day. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash judged this a Rollout watch item, not a deliverable.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:ci_main_delta_select (verdict jq "| sort_by(.created_at // "") | ... last ..."); also scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh review_final_ci_sweep_base_ci_red and scripts/check_failure_triage.sh base gate | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Push and scheduled runs on main are in different concurrency groups (ci-push-<ref> and ci-schedule-<ref>) and run at the same time, but every reader takes the base as the run created last, not the one completed last. In the S 22:30 / P1 22:35 / P2 23:00 sequence, P2 picks the green P1 over the red S.
  WHY: The red full-suite result is dropped, which breaks Goal 4 ("a red base stays red until a full run passes") and Goal 6. Every following push posts ci/final success "(delta suite)" until the next timer run. Fix: sort_by(.updated_at // .created_at // "") in all readers, keeping "pending" in the triage gate.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:ci_main_delta_run_tests (limit="${CI_MAIN_DELTA_TEST_TIMEOUT_SECS:-840}", tests_timed_out branch); .github/workflows/ci.yml tests-main-delta "timeout-minutes: 20"; scripts/ci_budget_watch.py DEFAULT_JOB_WARN_RATIO = 0.75 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The timeout fallback runs for the 840 s deadline plus the earlier steps, which leaves about 60 s of headroom before 900 s.
  WHY: budget-watch files or re-files an ai:ci-budget issue on the expected fallback path. Fix: about a 600 s default.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:CI_MAIN_DELTA_SHARDED_TESTS=( "tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py" ) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Modules that ci.yml shards inside one job are run whole and serially, and the selector's "functions" narrowing is ignored: heal_shards=4 at line 1803, pc_shards=4 at line 2402, wg2_shards=4 at line 3046, wg1_shards=4 at line 3274, ub_shards=4 at line 3893, mt_shards=3 at line 4280.
  WHY: A change such as one to scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py times out the 14-minute deadline and then runs the full suite. Fix: add these modules to CI_MAIN_DELTA_SHARDED_TESTS.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. 3-vs-4 jobs is not a gap (the changelog says "4 after (with budget-watch)"). The promotion sentence is a Rollout watch item. A full run inside the same run is acceptable under Approach 3.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items): (a) ci_main_delta_select "(.affected_tests // []) as $a": emit "invalid" unless has("affected_tests") and the value is an array, about 2 lines. (b) the bare gh api runs read: retry up to 3 times before read_failed, about 4 lines. (c) the ci_sync_quick.sh source with ">/dev/null 2>&1 || true": if CI_SYNC_QUICK_WIRING_PATHS is empty, call ci_main_delta_full select wiring_list_missing, about 3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:160-176 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Base run selection sorts by `created_at` and picks the last run, so a delta push P created after scheduled run S but finishing first can be picked as the base.
  WHY: If S fails, the next push sees a green base, which fails Goal 4 and Goal 6.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:225, 232-236, 286-290 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `.affected_tests // []` defaults to an empty list when the key is null or missing.
  WHY: A selector failure or malformed output is treated as "no tests affected", sets full_required=false, and posts CI success on an untested tree.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:85-88 (ci_main_delta_output) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `ci_main_delta_output` suppresses errors when writing `GITHUB_OUTPUT`.
  WHY: The job proceeds as success, and lint accepts the gated jobs as skipped, posting CI success on an untested tree.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:105-107 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Scheduled full runs on `main` share one concurrency group without `cancel-in-progress`.
  WHY: Only one pending run is kept per group, so a pending scheduled run can be replaced at the next 6-hour tick and the full suite is not guaranteed every 6 hours.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:349 (limit calculation) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The timeout fallback takes about 15-17 minutes of wall time, at or above budget-watch's 0.75x threshold (15m).
  WHY: Every timed-out push makes `budget-watch` file an `ai:ci-budget` issue.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: “Per push to main, 47 jobs before, 3 after (static-checks, the delta job, lint)” and “A push to main starts 3 jobs, not 47.”
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, budget-watch job
  Evidence of absence: budget-watch remains a separate job whose condition includes pushes to `main` at lines 5122-5141, including the push condition at line 5129, so a qualifying push starts at least four jobs, not three.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: “No promotion starts without a full run from the same day.”
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml or scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh
  Evidence of absence: Neither promotion file is changed. The existing promotion cycle proceeds directly to its gate-only release workflow; no code verifies that a scheduled full ci.yml run completed successfully that day.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
